correctness.rationale: The 24 unit roots are exactly specified. Exhaustive exact enumeration of all 10626 unordered quadruples with agreement of Gram and four independent minor computations gives the complete D spectrum and 72 maximizing disphenoids. The checker verifies no two maxima share three vertices, exactly 1152 orthogonal maps and their transitive maximum orbit. Convexity of wedge norm extends the bound to arbitrary contained tetrahedra; equality plus no-shared-three proves all 72 are the only global maximizers. Geometric normalization and gap are obtained explicitly.
